hypothesis.description: A falsifiable assumption the idea depends on.
hypothesis.title: Hypothesis

metric.description: What to measure and the threshold that would validate it.
metric.title: Metric

risk.description: A specific way this startup could fail.
risk.title: Risk

description: Adversarial review of everything the earlier crews concluded.

project_id.description: Project id, copied from the prompt.
project_id.title: Project Id

bull_case.description: 3-5 strongest arguments FOR the idea, each citing a prior-crew finding.
bull_case.title: Bull Case

bear_case.description: 3-5 strongest arguments AGAINST the idea, each citing a prior-crew finding.
bear_case.title: Bear Case

pre_mortem.description: Three years from now the startup failed. 4-6 sentences on why, in past tense.
pre_mortem.title: Pre Mortem

testable_hypotheses.description: 3-5 assumptions to test first, cheapest first.
testable_hypotheses.title: Testable Hypotheses

verdict.description: go: build it. pivot: promising core, change the plan. no-go: do not pursue as described.
verdict.title: Verdict

verdict_rationale.description: 2-4 sentences justifying the verdict from the evidence.
verdict_rationale.title: Verdict Rationale

would_change_my_mind.description: 2-4 concrete pieces of evidence that would flip the verdict.
would_change_my_mind.title: Would Change My Mind

pivot_suggestions.description: 0-3 alternative directions if verdict is pivot or no-go.
pivot_suggestions.title: Pivot Suggestions

overall_survival_score.description: Probability-like score (0-100) that the idea survives its top risks.
overall_survival_score.title: Overall Survival Score

confidence_score.description: Confidence in this verdict, 0.0-1.0; lower it when evidence is thin.
confidence_score.title: Confidence Score
